excerpt.zh: 该终末光环正受到能衰装置的挑战，这些外来机械可衰减灵能。我等受其主宰之意志所驱，必须拆解这些亵渎之器。
excerpt.en: The Aura of the End is being challenged by foreign devices capable of psionic attenuation. The will of our patron compels us to dismantle these blasphemous machines.
